title: Dismissal Slip
summary: Show the newest request as a slip the student can show at the school gate.

steps.title: Add the header
steps.objective: Start the Dismissal Slip screen with a title bar.
steps.concept: A header sits at the top of a screen and tells people where they are.
steps.expected: A title bar appears at the top of the phone.

expect.label: A Header sits in the Header zone of Dismissal Slip
expect.fail: Drag the Header tool onto the glowing Header zone.

hints: Find the glowing Header tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Header zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Header, then tap the glowing Header zone.

steps.title: Name your screen
steps.objective: Give the screen a clear title.
steps.concept: The header will say “Dismissal Slip”. A clear title means nobody gets lost.

expect.label: The header says exactly: Dismissal Slip

hints: Click the header on the phone to select it.
Edit Text content in the Properties panel.

steps.title: Add the slip
steps.concept: The slip shows the newest dismissal request in full: reference number, student, SID, grade, day, date, time and reason.
steps.expected: A slip panel appears in the Body zone.

expect.label: A Latest slip sits in the Body zone of Dismissal Slip
expect.fail: Drag the Latest slip tool onto the glowing Body zone.

hints: Find the glowing Latest slip tool in the toolbox on the left.
Drag it onto the glowing Body zone of the phone.
On a touch screen: tap Latest slip, then tap the glowing Body zone.

steps.title: Write the gate note
steps.objective: Tell the student what to do with the slip.
steps.concept: A short instruction makes the slip easy to use.
steps.expected: Your note appears on the screen.

cmds: ADD TEXT "Show this slip at the school gate."

expect.text: Show this slip at the school gate.
expect.label: The message is exactly: Show this slip at the school gate.

hints: ADD TEXT adds a line of text.
Put the text inside straight quotation marks.
Copy the command from the step card exactly, then press Run Commands.

target.text: Show this slip at the school gate.

steps.title: Final style check: every colour, border, shadow and style
steps.objective: Give your screens the same colours, shapes and shadows as the model app.
steps.concept: Colours were chosen while you built each element. Now finish the whole look: every colour, background, border, corner, shadow and text style below must match the model app you tried at the start. Items you already set show a tick.
steps.expected: Your screens look exactly like the model app.
hints: Click the element on the phone first. The style box (Choose colours, borders and corners) opens by itself.
Follow the sub-steps one by one: each says which row to use and which option to click. The red dot shows where.
Text alignment and weight are in the Properties panel (right) under “Text and layout”.

target.text: Show this slip at the school gate.

steps.title: Run and view your slip
steps.objective: See the slip for your latest request.
steps.concept: The slip shows the newest request with its reference. Show it at the gate.
steps.expected: Your slip appears with all the details.

expect.name: viewed:latest:dismissals
expect.label: You saw your dismissal slip
expect.fail: Send a request in Module 3 first, then run this screen.

subs.t: Press Run Project in the top bar

hints: The slip shows your latest request.
If it is empty, send a request in Module 3 first.

objectives: Show the newest request as a slip for the school gate.
Add a clear instruction for the student.
Run the finished app from start to end.

mcqs.q: Why does the slip show the newest request?
a: The gate needs the latest request, not an old one
mcqs.why: A slip should match the request the student just made.

mcqs.q: What is a reference number on a slip for?
a: To identify exactly which record it belongs to
mcqs.why: A reference lets staff look up or verify the record.

mcqs.q: Why show a status such as "Pending approval"?
a: It tells people what stage the request is at

mcqs.q: Which details make a slip useful at the school gate?
a: Student name, date, time, reason and reference
mcqs.why: The slip must answer who, when and why at a glance.

mcqs.q: What is needed to share your finished app as an Android app?
a: Package it and publish it through a developer account
Email the screen to a friend
mcqs.why: Packaging turns the web app into something stores accept.
